summary: Iter 13 both-scope testing completed: backend WhatsBoost preference/OTP/notification regressions passed via API + mocked provider tests, and mobile web login behavior validated under intentional OTP provider-off mode.

ui_bugs.issue: OTP hint can briefly show the generic 'secure OTP SMS' copy before auth config resolves to provider-off, causing transient misleading state.

integration_issues.flow: Authenticated subscriber profile toggle validation from mobile UI
integration_issues.issue: Could not navigate to authenticated subscriber profile screen because public OTP is intentionally provider-off (503/429 fail-closed). API/source validation completed instead.

action_items: Optional UI polish: prevent initial optimistic OTP hint and render provider-off copy only after /api/auth/config resolves.
Align frontend backend URL key usage with platform policy by supporting EXPO_BACKEND_URL in src/api.ts (currently uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL path).
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsBoost coverage is correctly guarded and tested: no secret leakage in tested API responses and no real provider call in idempotency/non-delivery tests (MOCKED).
backend/server.py remains very large (>700 lines); split auth/notifications/payments/complaints modules for safer future changes and targeted security reviews.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (mobile login + provider-off behavior verified; authenticated profile UI blocked by intentional OTP-off policy)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Temporary test user/data for mocked non-delivery test was cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use iter13 test file for regression of /me/whatsapp-preference authz/defaults, provider-off OTP contract (503 then 429), source-level toggle wiring, and WhatsBoost idempotency + non-rollback with provider calls MOCKED only.
rca_of_issue: UI limitation is environmental by policy: secure auth is intentionally fail-closed without configured SMS provider, so subscriber-profile toggle cannot be reached through public OTP login. Backend/API behavior and source wiring were validated instead.
